hero_h1: We've shown up every week for over fifteen years.
hero_lead: Fresh produce is Bungle's heartland. We have supplied premium Australian citrus and table grapes to Australia's major grocery retailers continuously since 2011 — navels, Valencias, Cara Caras, easy-peelers, Crimson Seedless, Red Globe and more. Weekly tendering, strict specification compliance, FRESHCARE and HARPS certification maintained throughout. Fifteen years of consistent supply to the most demanding retail programmes in Australia.
quality_heading: What major retailers require — and how we meet it.
quality_intro: Supplying fruit to Australia's major retailers means meeting detailed, constantly evolving quality standards — assessed at the orchard, in the packing shed, and again at the retailer's distribution centre. These are the things that matter most, and how we deliver them, week in and week out.
requirements_heading: Five things major retailers demand of every supplier.
requirements_intro: Bungle meets all of them. Here's exactly how.
landscape_heading: From the major chains to independents and PNG retail.
